name: margin-companion
description: Shows Margin's notes in the editor margin only at natural pauses, and quietly offers a break after a long quiet stretch. Never pops up.

margin.pauseSeconds.description: Seconds without typing that count as a natural pause. Held notes appear at a pause.

margin.quietMinutes.description: Minutes of quiet (no typing, or mostly deleting) before the status bar quietly offers a break.

margin.suggestBreaks.description: Quietly offer a break in the status bar after a long quiet stretch. It never pops up.
